question: is a paired interleaved A/B ratio sound on a permanently contended box, and if so what is the decode ratio for Phi-3.5

frame.lane: shipping host-KV lane (sess.run, KV round trip paid every step)
frame.phase_of_inference: decode only (one token per step); no prefill is measured

reference.arm_b: ORT CPUExecutionProvider, same process, same graph, same inputs
reference.second_gpu_ep: NOT AVAILABLE — onnxruntime-directml publishes no wheel at this ORT version (max 1.24.4 against this process's 1.28.0), and the Vulkan EP is loaded through the 1.28 plugin-EP ABI, so DirectML and this EP cannot be placed in one process on this machine today
reference.ratio_is_a_ratio_of: this EP on this GPU against ORT's CPU EP on this CPU — an end-to-end system ratio that confounds the EP with the device. It is NOT a comparison of two GPU EPs and may not be quoted as evidence about kernel quality.

clock_producer.why: PERF.md §16.3: the Intel clock axis is `none_available` on this machine, permanently. No MHz-carrying counter set, no WMI class, no nvidia-smi equivalent, and engine Running Time is a duration (same-source).

idle_accounting.red_if: median (busy+idle)/(cores*wall) departs from 1.0 by more than 5%

own_cpu_not_exceeding_busy.red_if: our own process tree used more CPU than the machine reports as busy

monitor_not_perturbing.red_if: the sampler's own CPU cost exceeds 0.05 cores, at which point the instrument is part of the load it is measuring

injection.witness: the launch of the injecting processes plus the utilisation/clock series. NOT the tenancy verdict: the injected processes are our own descendants, so probe_gpustate's ancestry classifier calls them ours and the board still reads SOLE_TENANT while a second copy of Phi-3.5 runs on it.

apparatus_cost.reading: what each arm's own step time does when the pairing apparatus is applied to it, with no foreign load added at all: first co-residency (the other arm's session alive in the process), then interleaving (alternating with it). A pairing that perturbs one arm and not the other has manufactured the asymmetry it was adopted to remove, and the ratio it publishes is a ratio of two perturbed arms rather than of two arms.
apparatus_cost.why: applying the apparatus multiplies the Vulkan arm by 0.968x and the reference arm by 0.858x; a ratio published from the paired phase therefore carries a factor of 1.128x that belongs to the instrument, not to the EP

cpuload.why: the ratio moved 0.6379x under a disturbance the arms did not share (vk 1.056x vs cpu 1.655x)

gpuload.why: neither arm's level moved, so the invariance test had no disturbance to be invariant to

output_agreement.note: argmax of logits per decode step, both arms, same seed past. A full per-output AGREE is Trinity's instrument; this is the liveness form of it.

not_established: prefill — every step here is a single-token decode; nothing was measured about the prompt phase, which has a completely different arithmetic intensity
any other model — Phi-3.5 mini int4 only, and its Nq/Nkv = 1.00 is the degenerate case of the grouped-attention axis
long context — past_len 4..8 only; the shipping lane OOMs at past 4096 on the 8 GB discrete card, so the ratio at long context is not 'worse', it is 'does not run'
a quiet machine — this is a ratio measured under contention, and it is not a prediction of what either arm would do alone
kernel quality — arm B is a CPU EP on a CPU, so the ratio confounds the EP with the device it runs on
